# Longbridge Content

⚠️ **Finance warning / Avertissement finance** : informational only, not investment advice. News flow and filing narratives arrive after the events they describe and are written by the companies themselves in the case of filings: trading on a headline or on management's own framing can move you after the market has already moved, there is a real risk of loss in any position taken from a news item, and no output here is a promise of return. Curated by Skill Harbor: the content skill of longbridge/skills, published by the broker Longbridge itself. Use it to fetch the latest news articles for a symbol (including the full article content), list and fetch company regulatory filings and announcements, read community discussion topics for a symbol with keyword search, and analyze SEC EDGAR documents narratively: 10-K risk factors and management discussion, 10-Q quarterly reports, 8-K material events, proxy statements and Form 4 insider filings, with the skill routing structured insider trade data questions to the sibling research skill instead. It also carries a regulatory rules knowledge base covering A-share price limits, Hong Kong T+0, the US pattern day trader rule, circuit breakers and margin requirements. The CLI commands (news, filing, topic) are public with no login required according to the skill metadata, which marks the skill read-only, and an MCP server is the fallback when the CLI is unavailable.
